============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v26.5.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |    823 ns | 1,215,210 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1220 ns | 819,618 | 341 | 1.48x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2156 ns | 463,854 | 341 | 2.62x slower |
| google-protobuf |   4610 ns | 216,897 | 341 | 5.60x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   3396 ns | 294,499 | 622 | 4.13x slower |
| JSON |   1710 ns | 584,955 | 791 | 2.08x slower |
